title: DSP Palette: Distinctness-First Palette Extraction for Accessible Design Systems
description: Code and evaluation data for Distinctness-First Palette Selection (DSP), a constrained greedy algorithm that selects perceptually distinct, WCAG-accessible color palettes from images. Companion repository to the paper accepted to APSIPA ASC 2026, Track IVM.

creators.name: Semoglou, Michail
creators.affiliation: College of Design and Innovation, Tongji University
